units.source_text: 父亲与住持阔别多年又重逢，甚为兴奋，

en.t: My father was deeply excited to meet the abbot again after so many years apart,

units.source_text: 本已相当劳顿了，可一提及金阁，

en.t: and although he was already quite exhausted, as soon as the Golden Pavilion was mentioned,

units.source_text: 他端了一口气，抓住我的肩膀就跟着走了。

en.t: he drew a breath, seized my shoulder, and followed along.
